vex_invalid_cve_format.detail: Invalid CVE ID format. Must match pattern: CVE-YYYY-NNNN+

vex_empty_vulnerabilities.detail: Vulnerabilities list cannot be empty. At least one vulnerability assessment required.

vex_cve_not_found_in_document.detail: CVE not found in VEX document: CVE-9999-9999

vex_invalid_state.detail: Invalid VEX state. Must be one of: exploitable, in_triage, not_affected, resolved, false_positive

vex_invalid_justification.detail: Invalid justification. Must be one of: code_not_present, code_not_reachable, requires_configuration, requires_dependency, requires_environment, protected_by_compiler, protected_at_runtime, protected_at_perimeter, protected_by_mitigating_control

vex_justification_without_not_affected.detail: Justification can only be provided when state is 'not_affected'

vex_unauthorized.detail: Authentication required. Please provide a valid X-API-Key header.

vex_forbidden.detail: You do not have permission to access this VEX document.

vex_internal_error.detail: Internal server error during VEX creation
